content.short: Narval is a multi-player Web3 wallet platform for organizations.
content.description: Narval is a multi-player wallet platform that helps organizations securely store, govern, and use their NFTs and digital assets. It provides web3-native policy controls and a flexible custody model, enabling teams to manage permissions, custody, and access across ecosystems. Built for Guilds, DAOs, NFT Funds and developers, Narval helps move NFTs out of vaults into active, governed workflows while maintaining security and compliance across trusted collaborators.
